prompt: For a small engineering team building long-running Codex workflows, compare a skill-orchestrated isolated-agent harness with a single-agent workflow. Use current official OpenAI documentation and Anthropic's harness-design article, identify when an independent evaluator is worth its cost, and produce a recommendation with an evidence table and risk matrix.

baseline.instructions: Run in a fresh Codex task without invoking deep-research-harness. Allow normal web tools and ask for one final report.

harness.instructions: Run the identical prompt in a fresh Codex task with deep-research-harness explicitly invoked.
harness.interrupt_after: all round-1 Scout artifacts validate and before Writer starts
harness.resume_instruction: Resume the recorded task_id and finish the research run.
